newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares extend bull-run on PM new term.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares extend bull-run on PM new term.

text.p: Slovenian shares continued their bull-run on Friday, storming 1.47 percent higher and traders said the nomination of Janez Drnovsek for a second term as Prime Minister would continue to encourage buying.
"I think this stampede will continue for a while, unless some foreign investors decide to cash in their profits," Karmen Cerar, a trader at brokers Poteza said.
* The 10-share SBI index rose 18.47 points to 1,290.5.
* Overall 12 shares rose, three fell and two were unchanged, while another eight were untraded.
* Lek's A issue was the most actively traded, jumping 6.32 percent to 24,400 tolars on volume of 11,485 shares. -- Ljubljana, newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
